scope: Evidence review and approximation ledger for Home Village Super Wizard Chain Magic.

sources.title: Balance Changes Now Live
sources.finding: Super Wizard chain damage was reduced from 60% to 40%.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.finding: All Super Wizard levels received a damage buff and levels 9–14 received HP buffs; it does not define Chain Magic geometry or timing.

sources.title: The December 2020 update is live
sources.finding: Chain Magic can chain up to 10 times only to buildings within range of the original target.

sources.title: Super Wizard | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.finding: The branches originate at the primary target and can hit up to nine other nearby targets for 40% damage, described as ten total targets.

established: Home Village Super Wizard L9–14 remains in scope and has immutable per-level data in the pinned catalogue.
Secondary chain impact is 40% of the primary damage, corroborated by the primary 2021 balance change.
Secondary branches originate from the primary target rather than chaining sequentially from the prior secondary target.
unresolved: The public descriptions conflict or are ambiguous about whether a maximum of ten means ten total victims or ten secondary bounces.
No source gives a current versioned chain-radius value; 'within range of the original target' cannot silently be equated to the base attack range.
No source establishes target eligibility, distance/entity-ID tie break, simultaneous versus serial application, projectile launch/travel, target destruction during selection, or fixed-tick ordering.
No source verifies sprite alignment, chain overlay geometry or animation timing.
decision: Enabled as core_supported_secondary_partial through the additive Super Wizard reference. Core branches from the primary target with primary 40% secondary damage, ten total victims and a three-tile base-range proxy; cap, radius, eligibility and flight remain explicit replaceable approximations.
